plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-13 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Mathematics - Applied Mathematics Emphasis program page (poid=10874) and its linked official degree map, 'Mathematics & Mathematics Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'Applied Math (Campus)' (the workbook's Index lists Online as N/A for this program), last updated/reviewed July 27, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (16/16/14/15/16/15/13/15) and the plan to the catalog's printed Total Credits, BS Degree: 120. Per the catalog, all courses must be passed with a C (2.0) or better to be counted in the major. The catalog's Support Courses (10 credits) are exercised exactly by the map's two 5-credit 'CHEM/PHYS Lecture & Lab Courses**' rows, each carrying the catalog's two sequences (Chemistry CHEM 1210/1215 and CHEM 1220/1225; Physics PHYS 2210/2215 and PHYS 2220/2225). The 'Complete Two of the Following' choice (6 credits) is exercised by the map's two 'CS/ENGR/MATH Programming or Applied Math Course*' rows carrying the catalog's five options. The Emphasis Electives (12 credits) are exercised exactly by the map's one 'Major Emphasis Elective*' row and three 'Major Upper-division Emphasis Elective*' rows, each carrying the catalog's 12-credit list. DISCLOSED catalog-vs-map differences, transcribed as printed and not reconciled: (1) the catalog prints MATH 2210 Calculus III at 4 credits while the Applied Math map prints it at 3 credits in Fall Year 2, the value recorded here and the value at which that term sums to its printed 14 (the Actuarial Science map in the same workbook prints MATH 2210 at 4); at the map value the map exercises the catalog's Core Requirements at 39 credits against the catalog's printed 40-41 range (fixed core courses 30 at map values + the differential-equations choice at 3 + the two programming choices at 6). (2) The map prints the Spring Year 2 differential-equations row at 3-4 credits (the catalog's 'Complete One of the Following': MATH 2250 at 4 or MATH 2280 at 3) and its free-elective row at 2-3 credits; the choice slot is recorded at 3 credits and the free-elective row at 3 credits, the combination at which the term sums to its printed 15. The catalog's BS (12) and GE (28+) blocks overlap the major and free electives per the catalog's own notes, so the catalog blocks do not sum arithmetically to 120; the map's free-elective rows (22 credits, plus 15 credits of free upper-division electives) carry the balance as printed. Catalog course titles are recorded where the map shortens them (e.g. MATH 3700 Probability and Statistics).
